newsitem.title: USA: Interpore in license deal with Quantic.
newsitem.headline: Interpore in license deal with Quantic.

text.p: Interpore International Inc said it signed a license and development agreement with Quantic Biomedical Inc for rights to technology that produces a material with super-concentrated tissue growth factors derived from a patient's own blood.

It said the technology will be used in the joint development of a bone and cartilage repair product combining Interpore's Pro Osteon bone graft substitute material with Quantic's autologous growth factor concentrates. It said it expects to begin pre-clinical feasibility studies by the end of this year.
